entries.say.variants.default: Back fence still has a loose plank {scene.location}, {addressee.name}, and the rain barrels need checking. How are we looking on chores?
entries.reply.agreed.say.variants.default: Good, {addressee.name}. Grab a hammer and some nails—we'll get it buttoned up before dark.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.default: Fair enough. Let's leave the heavy hammering until morning so we don't draw anything.
entries.reply.checked_in.say.variants.default: It's holding for now {scene.location}, {addressee.name}, just needs another pair of hands when we get a quiet hour.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: Not the time for chores. Keep your eyes on the yard.
entries.reply.volunteer.say.variants.default: Hand me the crowbar—I'll knock that job out right now so nobody pulls double duty.
entries.reply.negotiate.say.variants.default: I'll haul timber for you, {addressee.name}, as long as somebody splits dusk watch with me.
entries.reply.refuse_unsafe_work.say.variants.de: Not walking out on an open roof while alarms and shots are echoing two blocks away.
entries.reply.reluctant.say.variants.default: Alright, though my back's tight—we're keeping it brief and quiet.
